description: This module provides utilities for parsing, cleaning, and previewing CSV files, including functions for normalizing column names, de-duplicating rows, and generating schema information for CSV data.

classes.name: ColumnProfile
classes.description: Data class representing profiling information for a CSV column, including name, counts of null and non-null values, unique value count, and example values.

methods.name: str _normalize_column_name(name: str)
methods.description: Normalizes a column name by trimming whitespace, replacing spaces with underscores, removing special characters, and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict[str,Any]],int] _dedupe_preserve_order(rows: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]], columns: Sequence[str])
methods.description: De-duplicates rows while preserving original order based on all column values.

methods.name: bool _is_missing(value: Any)
methods.description: Determines if a given value should be considered missing (None, empty string, or whitespace).

methods.name: csv.Dialect _sniff_dialect(sample_text: str)
methods.description: Attempts to detect the CSV dialect (delimiter, quote character, etc.) from a sample text.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_and_clean_csv( raw_bytes: bytes, *, filename: str, max_rows: int = 50_000, preview_rows: int = 25, )
methods.description: Main function to parse a CSV file from bytes, validate and clean the data, de-duplicate rows, generate schema profiling, and produce a preview for user inspection.

ctags.name: parse_and_clean_csv
ctags.signature: ( raw_bytes: bytes, *, filename: str, max_rows: int = 50_000, preview_rows: int = 25, )
